# Dr. Crista

> Dr. Jill Crista's comprehensive platform for mold illness diagnosis, treatment, and recovery guidance combining naturopathic expertise with evidence-based wellness education.

Dr. Crista specializes in mold-related illness, PANDAS/PANS, and integrative health recovery. The site offers educational resources, practitioner training, published books, supplement products, and online courses for both patients and medical professionals seeking mold recovery and wellness guidance.

## Key Topics

- Mold illness and mold toxicity
- PANDAS and PANS
- Dr. Jill Crista
- Mycotoxin exposure
- Integrative medicine
- Mold recovery
- Detoxification
- Supplements and wellness products
- Practitioner training and CME
- Online courses and health education
- Break The Mold Book
- Liposomal D+K
- Biocidin and Dentalcidin
- Clinical questionnaires
- Guided meditation and wellness
